summary.zh-CN: 修复会话误锁死，恢复存储访问后无需重启即可续聊，并补全底层故障诊断。Issue #73 原机首次触发仍在调查。
summary.en-US: Fix incorrectly locked conversations, resume after storage recovers without restarting, and retain underlying diagnostics. The first trigger reported in Issue #73 remains under investigation.

title.zh-CN: 已保存正文后的摘要错误不再锁会话
title.en-US: Summary failures no longer lock saved conversations

body.zh-CN: 正文已保存时，目录摘要或预览错误单独记录，不再永久拒绝输入。冷启动时单个会话读取错误不会阻断其它正常会话。
body.en-US: Catalog summary or preview failures after content was saved are reported separately without permanently refusing input. One unreadable conversation no longer blocks healthy conversations during startup scanning.

title.zh-CN: 存储恢复后无需重启续聊
title.en-US: Resume after storage recovers without restarting

body.zh-CN: 存储故障仍明确停止当前运行。保留当前进程中未执行的排队输入，恢复访问后继续发送即可核对历史、确认写入并续跑；已开始执行的失败请求不会自动重跑。退出进程后不保证保留未执行输入，不能找回从未保存的内容。
body.en-US: Storage faults still stop the affected run clearly. Unexecuted queued input remains in the current process; sending again after access returns checks history and confirms a recovery write before continuing. Already executed failed requests are not replayed automatically. Unexecuted input is not guaranteed after process exit, and never-saved content cannot be recovered.

body.zh-CN: 日志保留原因链、系统错误码、路径、失败阶段和回滚结果。日志目录不可访问时不再反向打断聊天，恢复访问后继续写入日志。
body.en-US: Logs retain cause chains, system error codes, paths, failure stages, and rollback results. Unavailable log directories no longer interrupt conversations, and logging resumes when access returns.
